text: Every pet's chart has a History tab. It's our own record of who entered or changed a prescription, a vaccine dose or a lab result, so questions get answered fast.
This is Maple's chart. Scroll down to Timeline.
It's for staff only, and it isn't part of the medical record.
Each row says when, which record, and what happened. Newest first.
Here's a lab result: entered by Jordan, our tech, then completed by Dr. Lane.
Her rabies tag was fixed after the dose was signed. The old tag and the new one are both shown.
And her Carprofen script: directions entered by Jordan for Dr. Lane, approved, and the label printed.
It never prints, it isn't in the records we send out, and families never see it in the portal.
Two mistakes to avoid: looking here for clinical notes, and sending it to a client. History is who did what, and it's for staff only.
